title: Government Economic Policies
author: oA7a2DXCeN3DLamvj
chapter_outcomes: Understand the main stages of the business cycle (e.g. growth, boom, recession and slump) and analyse how changes in employment, inflation, and GDP affect businesses.
Explain how government economic objectives and policies (taxation, spending, and interest rates) influence business activity and how firms may respond.

Analyse how business activities impact the environment and create external costs and benefits, how firms contribute to sustainable development, respond to environmental pressures and legal controls, and manage ethical issues arising from conflicts between profit and responsible practices.
Explain the concept and importance of globalisation, including its opportunities and threats for businesses and reasons for government trade protection measures.

Explain the reasons for the growth of multinational companies and evaluate their benefits and drawbacks for businesses, stakeholders, and host countries’ economies, including effects on jobs, investment, choice, local firms, and profit repatriation.
Explain exchange rate appreciation and depreciation and analyse how changes affect importers and exporters.
